title: adj list and adj inbox filter by an exact ref

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: A slice is ready to run only with no open design question (slicer rule u4; slicer s399 and s400, ork S116). Questions are linked to slices with `adj ask --ref S116`. `adj list` filters by status, tag and key only, and `adj check` matches a substring, so `S11` also matches `S110` and `S116`. A spec check cannot ask "which open records reference S116" exactly.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: `--ref REF` on `list` and `inbox`: an exact, case-sensitive match against a record's refs, repeatable, with every given filter matching as today.
